title: Lighthouse: Request Trace Lab for Progressive Error Triaging
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a lightweight, exploratory design prototype called 'Lighthouse Request Trace Lab' that surfaces progressive breadcrumbs, retry lineage, and payload delta overlays to accelerate root-cause triage for failed requests in the Console. This is a designer-led prototype to validate interaction patterns for: 1) correlating multi-attempt request timelines, 2) surfacing minimal payload diffs across retries, 3) presenting a compact error taxonomy with suggested remediation steps, and 4) integrating short-lived hypothesis runs (replay-with-override) to test fixes. The prototype should emphasize scanability, signal-to-noise controls, and easy handoff to Eng/PM for implementation planning.
goals: Reduce mean time to identify root cause for transient/logic errors by surfacing retry lineage and payload diffs
Validate a compact error taxonomy UI that maps error classes to recommended next actions (eg. retry, inspect input, check model variant)
Confirm feasibility of an in-panel lightweight replay runner that lets engineers re-run a request with a single-field override
Design an information density mode (compact vs expanded) for SREs and product engineers
acceptance_criteria: Clickable prototype in Figma and interactive flow in ProtoPie (or equivalent) demonstrating full triage journey
Prototype shows timeline with grouped attempts, per-attempt metrics (latency, tokens, model version) and an explicit retry-lineage graph
Payload delta overlay visualizes only fields that changed between attempts with color-coded confidence and ability to expand full JSON
Error taxonomy chip set that, when clicked, filters requests and surfaces suggested remediation text for each class
Replay control simulation that accepts a single-field override and shows expected downstream effects (mocked), with guardrail copy about production safety
Design tokens and accessibility checks included (contrast, font sizes, keyboard navigation)
design_notes: Avoid full-page inspector; keep Lab as a contextual panel that can float over dashboards and rollout traces
Prefer line-level diffs and color-coding over raw noise of full JSON diffs; allow 'show full JSON' as secondary action
Use micro-annotations on timeline nodes to display model variant, quantization profile, and whether KV cache hit occurred
Consider introducing a compact density toggle for high-throughput triage sessions
Prototype should record small sample transcripts to demonstrate privacy-safe obfuscation patterns for PII-sensitive payloads
dependencies: ENG-12021 (trace-export: include retry metadata and model-variant tags)
decisions: Start as side-panel modal anchored to request timeline rather than full page
Show only top 3 changed fields in compact view; reveal full diff on expand
Replay simulation will be explicit mock in prototype; implementation will require eng perf signoff
next_steps: Run 30-minute design workshop with Eng and PM to validate assumptions (schedule week of Mar 8)
Create Figma low-fi frames for timeline, delta overlay, and taxonomy chips (owner: Marcus)
Prototype a single 'replay with override' path to validate UX copy and guardrails
Collect 5 sample incidents from SRE to drive realistic payloads for prototype demos
notes: Existing designs focus on single-request playback; Lighthouse is intentionally multi-attempt-first
Keep language neutral about model internals when surfacing recommendations (eg. say 'suggested action' rather than 'fix model')
Prototype should include copy variants for internal SRE vs external customer-facing users
